component.name: FastMoji
component.summary: Light and fast popup emoji picker

description.p: FastMoji is a popup emoji picker for Linux built to be light and fast: written in Rust with Slint, it opens in a few milliseconds and uses a fraction of the memory of a typical toolkit-based picker. It is inspired by the Emote emoji picker.
On X11, press Ctrl+Alt+E (configurable) to open the picker. Selected emojis are copied to the clipboard and, when automatic paste is enabled, pasted into the app you were using.

ul.li: Search as you type, browse by category, and see your recent emojis first
Navigate with the arrow keys, Enter to select, Shift+Enter to build a multi-emoji selection
Skin tone and emoji size preferences
Optional: exit when closed to use no memory in the background

description.p: On Wayland, global shortcuts and automatic paste are not available yet: bind a desktop shortcut to the command "fastmoji --toggle". Emojis are still copied to the clipboard.
